//: Using what is near (16 §3, 12 §9.4): a list of every interaction within a step, and what walking into something closed does. Interactions are content of other mods; this mod defines no action, so its controls name `interact` bare, which means whichever loaded mod's action of that name comes first in order of id (the `core` mod's takes `target` and `interaction`). What is offered is the simulation's: `view.offers_near` lists each interaction the things round the character offer, with whether it can be done now and, where it cannot, why.
title: Use

list.item: {if it.available then it.name else ''}<dim>{if it.available then '' else it.name}  {it.where}{if it.available then '' else ': '}{if it.available then '' else it.why}</>
list.empty: There is nothing within reach to use.
list.tip: Enter does it; greyed, it cannot be done now, and says why.

tooltip.value: Up and Down choose, Enter does it, Esc goes back.

//: The key in play that opens the list above.
name: Use something near
doc: List what can be done with the things within a step, and do one.

//: What walking into something closed does, run by the application with what is there as `it` (a map: `target`, `interaction`, `name`, `where`, `available`, `why`). The preference `bump` says which of the two runs: `bump` does it at once, `bump_ask` asks first.
name: Use what is in the way
doc: Do what the thing walked into offers by default: open a shut door.

name: Ask before using what is in the way
doc: Ask, then do what the thing walked into offers by default.

name: Walking into a door
doc: What walking into something closed does: what it offers by default is done at once, asked about first, or not done, and the step is refused.
